name: Syntranova AI Receptionist – Phone & Chat
author: syntranova

sections.description:
Syntranova AI Receptionist answers your business phone 24/7, in your callers’ language, books appointments and sends you a summary of every call. This plugin connects it to your WordPress site:

  • A floating call button (“Call our AI receptionist · 24/7”) with your AI receptionist number, one tap to call on phones
  • The button text appears automatically in your site language (15 languages), or write your own
  • Your color, left or right, on all devices or phones only
  • Optional: the Syntranova AI Receptionist chat, pasted from your dashboard
  • Hide everything while you edit the site as administrator

Built for hotels, clinics, dental practices, salons, restaurants, law firms and every business that loses customers when nobody picks up.

The AI receptionist itself runs on Syntranova AI Receptionist, so you need an Syntranova AI Receptionist account and phone number.

External services

The call button is generated by this plugin on your own site and does not contact any external service. Tapping it opens the visitor’s phone app with the number you entered.

If you paste a chat embed code, the plugin loads that chat script from Syntranova AI Receptionist servers (aireceptionist.com.ai or our automation servers; other addresses are refused). When a visitor uses the chat, the messages, the page address and a random session identifier are sent to Syntranova AI Receptionist so the assistant can answer; contact details the visitor types are stored as a lead for the site owner.

The service is provided by Syntranova AL Ltd (Syntranova AI Receptionist): Terms of service, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New and activate it.
  2. Create your Syntranova AI Receptionist account at https://aireceptionist.com.ai/ and get your AI receptionist phone number.
  3. Go to Settings → Syntranova AI Receptionist and enter the number. The call button appears on your site.
  4. Optional: copy the chat embed code from your dashboard (Chat widget) and paste it in the Chat field.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Syntranova AI Receptionist account?

Yes. The plugin shows the call button and the chat; the AI receptionist that answers runs on Syntranova AI Receptionist.

Can I keep my current phone number?

Yes. You can forward your existing number to your AI receptionist, so customers keep calling the number they know.

Which languages does the AI receptionist speak?

It answers in the caller’s language, with 45+ languages supported.

Does the button slow down my site?

No. It is a few lines of HTML and CSS, without images or external files.
